full_page.content:
1952, September 3
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY ROUTE 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
September 3rd 1952
Blessed be God. In all His designs.
God bless you Mr. Fred Thomas.
Many thanks for your appreciated favor of August 20th which I just finished reading. I hope this finds you well and improving! For you, that means that by the grace of God you persevere in His holy grace and ser- vice -- resigned in all circumstances to His adorable will. Of course it is not wrong to pray for improve- ment of health, etc. But perhaps more meritorious to even offer ourselves to suffer something in union with our dear Lord's suffering and death for our holy Redemption -- remembering too that: "whom the Lord loveth He chastiseth." Keep courage therefore and I hope that before long - God willing - you surprise the doctors and all concerned.
(No Signature)
